# Exploration Recordings

> Exploration Recordings is an independent progressive house label from Sri Lanka - a home for visionary artists and boundary-pushing sound, curating only tracks that transcend the ordinary.

Exploration Recordings is a platform for visionary artists, a home for boundary-pushing sound. We curate only the most unique and specially crafted tracks that transcend the ordinary and speak to those who truly seek something deeper.

This isn’t just a label; it’s a movement - a space for those who understand that music is more than sound. It’s an exploration of artistry, emotion and innovation.

Founded in Sri Lanka in 2025 by Weligama producers JUNIOR and ALPHA21, the label opened its catalogue with the co-founders' own Time Machine EP, and followed it with the Liquid Aura EP alongside Poland's Sound Fusion - deep, driving progressive house, with remixes from Sri Lanka, Pakistan and Argentina.

## Key facts

- Type: independent record label
- Based in: Sri Lanka
- Founded: 2025
- Co-founders: ALPHA21 and JUNIOR
- Genre: Progressive house, Deep progressive, Melodic
- Catalogue: 2 EPs, 9 tracks
- Releases available on: Proton Radio (https://www.protonradio.com/labels/4587/exploration-recordings)
- Website: https://ravinduyas.github.io/folioblox-portfolio/

## Releases

### ER002 - Liquid Aura EP - JUNIOR & Sound Fusion

Released 3 July 2026. Progressive house. Buy / stream: https://www.protonradio.com/releases/293837/liquid-aura

Exploration Recordings continues its journey with ER002, welcoming co-founder JUNIOR alongside Sound Fusion for a powerful five-track statement. The EP features two originals, “Liquid Aura” and “Bleeding Shadow”, both rooted in deep progressive textures, hypnotic rhythms and emotional storytelling. Liquid Aura flows with subtle tension and immersive atmospheres, while Bleeding Shadow dives darker, driven by pulsating basslines and haunting melodic layers. On remix duties, Stereo Munk delivers a refined and dynamic reinterpretation, Juani Ramirez adds his signature melodic depth and groove precision, and RNDØM crafts a rolling underground version that pushes the energy forward. This release represents what Exploration Recordings stands for: exploration through sound, crafted with intention.

1. Liquid Aura (Original Mix) - 6:51
2. Liquid Aura (STEREO MUNK Remix) - 8:59
3. Liquid Aura (Juani Ramirez Remix) - 7:28
4. Liquid Aura (RNDØM Remix) - 7:57
5. Bleeding Shadow (Original Mix) - 7:08

### ER001 - Time Machine EP - ALPHA21 & JUNIOR

Released 21 September 2025. Progressive house. Buy / stream: https://www.protonradio.com/releases/270063/time-machine

Exploration Recordings opens its story with the debut EP from ALPHA21 & JUNIOR. Time Machine EP showcases their vision of deep, driving progressive house across two originals and two standout remixes. The title track Time Machine unfolds with hypnotic grooves and cinematic tension, while Gate 8 Journey offers a more atmospheric and melodic voyage. On remix duties, Rockka injects peak-time energy with a powerful melodic rework, and Imal SL strips the original into a rolling underground interpretation. A statement first release - setting the tone for the journeys ahead.

1. Time Machine (Original Mix) - 7:40
2. Time Machine (Rockka Remix) - 7:05
3. Time Machine (Imal SL Remix) - 7:37
4. Gate 8 Journey (Original Mix) - 7:35

## Artists

- [ALPHA21](https://ravinduyas.github.io/folioblox-portfolio/artists/alpha21/): Co-founder · DJ · Producer, Weligama, Sri Lanka. Label co-founder. Lush soundscapes and organic rhythms inspired by Sri Lanka's natural world; co-wrote the debut, Time Machine.
- [JUNIOR](https://ravinduyas.github.io/folioblox-portfolio/artists/junior-sl/): Co-founder · DJ · Producer, Weligama, Sri Lanka. Label co-founder. Emotional, soulful progressive house from Weligama, on both of the label's releases so far.
- [ESH (SL)](https://ravinduyas.github.io/folioblox-portfolio/artists/esh-sl/): DJ · Producer, Sri Lanka. Progressive and organic house - hypnotic grooves, atmospheric textures and melodic depth, shaped by years of DJing in Dubai.
- [DLC](https://ravinduyas.github.io/folioblox-portfolio/artists/dlc/): Artist, South coast, Sri Lanka. Melodic, driving progressive house built for peak time, from the south coast of Sri Lanka - shaped by a life spent surfing.
- [C-Groove](https://ravinduyas.github.io/folioblox-portfolio/artists/c-groove/): DJ · Producer. Rooted in the electronic scene since 2014 - driven by passion, dedication and a love for underground sound.

## Frequently asked questions

### What is Exploration Recordings?

Exploration Recordings is an independent progressive house record label from Sri Lanka, founded in 2025 by Weligama producers JUNIOR and ALPHA21. It releases deep, driving, melodic progressive house from Sri Lankan and international artists, and every release is available on Proton Radio.

### Who founded Exploration Recordings?

Exploration Recordings was co-founded in 2025 by JUNIOR and ALPHA21, two progressive house DJs and producers from Weligama, Sri Lanka. Their Time Machine EP was the label's first release.

### Where is Exploration Recordings based?

The label is based in Sri Lanka. Co-founders JUNIOR and ALPHA21 are from Weligama, DLC is from the south coast, and ESH (SL) is Sri Lanka–based after years performing in Dubai. Releases also feature collaborators and remixers from Poland, Pakistan and Argentina.

### What has Exploration Recordings released?

2 EPs so far: ER001 Time Machine by ALPHA21 & JUNIOR (21 September 2025), with remixes from Rockka and Imal SL; ER002 Liquid Aura by JUNIOR & Sound Fusion (3 July 2026), with remixes from STEREO MUNK, Juani Ramirez and RNDØM.

### What kind of music does the label release?

Progressive house - deep textures, hypnotic rhythms and emotional, melodic storytelling, from slow-burning atmospheric originals to rolling underground and peak-time remixes. The label curates only unique, specially crafted tracks.

### Where can I buy or stream Exploration Recordings releases?

Every release is on Proton Radio, where you can buy or stream each EP and its individual tracks. Each release on this site links straight to its Proton Radio page.

### How do I book an Exploration Recordings artist?

Use the booking form: choose an artist (or leave it open for a recommendation), add the date, city, venue and fee offer, and the label replies within 48 hours with availability.

### How do I submit a demo to Exploration Recordings?

Use the Demo Submission page on this site. Send finished tracks only, each with a title, in one private SoundCloud link - no downloads or attachments. Every demo gets listened to and answered.
